import struct, zlib

def create_png\(filepath, pixels\):
    # pixels is 16x16 list of \(r,g,b,a\) tuples
    width, height = 16, 16
    
    # PNG signature
    sig = b''\\x89PNG\\r\\n\\x1a\\n''
    
    # IHDR chunk
    ihdr_data = struct.pack\(''>IIBBBBB'', width, height, 8, 6, 0, 0, 0\)  # 8-bit RGBA
    ihdr_crc = zlib.crc32\(b''IHDR'' + ihdr_data\) & 0xffffffff
    ihdr = struct.pack\(''>I'', 13\) + b''IHDR'' + ihdr_data + struct.pack\(''>I'', ihdr_crc\)
    
    # IDAT chunk
    raw = b''''
    for y in range\(height\):
        raw += b''\\x00''  # filter byte
        for x in range\(width\):
            r, g, b, a = pixels[y][x]
            raw += struct.pack\(''BBBB'', r, g, b, a\)
    
    compressed = zlib.compress\(raw\)
    idat_crc = zlib.crc32\(b''IDAT'' + compressed\) & 0xffffffff
    idat = struct.pack\(''>I'', len\(compressed\)\) + b''IDAT'' + compressed + struct.pack\(''>I'', idat_crc\)
    
    # IEND chunk
    iend_crc = zlib.crc32\(b''IEND''\) & 0xffffffff
    iend = struct.pack\(''>I'', 0\) + b''IEND'' + struct.pack\(''>I'', iend_crc\)
    
    with open\(filepath, ''wb''\) as f:
        f.write\(sig + ihdr + idat + iend\)

                px[y][x] = \(bright, int\(bright*0.75\), int\(bright*0.3\), 255\)
        # Border glow
        dist = math.sqrt\(\(x-7.5\)**2 + \(y-7.5\)**2\)
        if 5.5 < dist < 7 and px[y][x] == \(0,0,0,0\):
            px[y][x] = \(180, 140, 60, 120\)
        elif dist <= 5.5 and px[y][x] == \(0,0,0,0\):
            px[y][x] = \(100, 80, 40, 180\)
create_png\(base + ''photonic_matrix.png'', px\)

# Condensed Light - bright white/yellow orb with glow
px = [[\(0,0,0,0\)]*16 for _ in range\(16\)]
for y in range\(16\):
    for x in range\(16\):
        dist = math.sqrt\(\(x-7.5\)**2 + \(y-7.5\)**2\)
        if dist < 3:
            px[y][x] = \(255, 255, 240, 255\)
        elif dist < 5:
            alpha = int\(255 * \(1 - \(dist-3\)/2\)\)
            px[y][x] = \(255, 245, 200, alpha\)
        elif dist < 7:
            alpha = int\(150 * \(1 - \(dist-5\)/2\)\)
            px[y][x] = \(255, 230, 150, alpha\)
create_png\(base + ''condensed_light.png'', px\)

# Exotic Matter - dark purple/void with shimmer
px = [[\(0,0,0,0\)]*16 for _ in range\(16\)]
for y in range\(16\):
    for x in range\(16\):
        dist = math.sqrt\(\(x-7.5\)**2 + \(y-7.5\)**2\)
        if dist < 6:
            # Dark core
            base_r = int\(40 + 20 * math.sin\(x * 0.8 + y * 0.5\)\)
            base_g = int\(10 + 10 * math.sin\(x * 0.5 + y * 0.8\)\)
            base_b = int\(60 + 30 * math.sin\(x * 0.6 - y * 0.3\)\)
            # Shimmer highlights
            shimmer = math.sin\(x * 1.2\) * math.cos\(y * 1.5\)
            if shimmer > 0.6:
                base_r = min\(255, base_r + 80\)
                base_b = min\(255, base_b + 100\)
            alpha = 255 if dist < 5 else int\(255 * \(1 - \(dist-5\)\)\)
            px[y][x] = \(base_r, base_g, base_b, alpha\)
create_png\(base + ''exotic_matter.png'', px\)

print\(''Done: created 3 placeholder textures''\)

BG = \(198, 198, 198, 255\)        # standard light grey background 0xC6C6C6
DARK = \(55, 55, 55, 255\)         # top/left border
LIGHT = \(255, 255, 255, 255\)     # bottom/right border
INNER = \(139, 139, 139, 255\)     # inner slot fill

# Step 1: Erase old upgrade slot outlines on the far right
# They are at approximately \(151,7\), \(151,25\), \(151,43\), each 18x18
for sy in [7, 25, 43]:
    for y in range\(sy, sy + 18\):
        for x in range\(151, 151 + 18\):
            img.putpixel\(\(x, y\), BG\)

# Step 2: Draw 3 new vanilla-style slot outlines at \(30,7\), \(30,25\), \(30,43\)
def draw_slot\(img, sx, sy\):
    """Draw an 18x18 vanilla inventory slot at \(sx, sy\)."""
    # Top-left corner pixel
    img.putpixel\(\(sx, sy\), DARK\)
    # Top edge: x+1 to x+16
    for x in range\(sx + 1, sx + 17\):
        img.putpixel\(\(x, sy\), DARK\)
    # Left edge: y+1 to y+16
    for y in range\(sy + 1, sy + 17\):
        img.putpixel\(\(sx, y\), DARK\)
    # Bottom edge: x to x+17 at y+17
    for x in range\(sx, sx + 18\):
        img.putpixel\(\(x, sy + 17\), LIGHT\)
    # Right edge: x+17, y to y+17
    for y in range\(sy, sy + 18\):
        img.putpixel\(\(sx + 17, y\), LIGHT\)
    # Inner 16x16 fill
    for y in range\(sy + 1, sy + 17\):
        for x in range\(sx + 1, sx + 17\):
            img.putpixel\(\(x, y\), INNER\)

for sy in [7, 25, 43]:
    draw_slot\(img, 30, sy\)

img.save\(img_path\)
print\(f"Saved fixed texture to {img_path}"\)
print\(f"Image size: {img.size}"\)
PYEOF)
